messages.author: Zafar,Muhammad Saqlain
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users,
I want to calculate the Tetrahedral Order Parameter q of Water
I run NPT on TIP4P/EW water model and i have trajactory file eq_npt.nc and topology file wtr_1.prmtop, kindly let me know cpptraj script to calculate tetrahedral order parameter q.
I looked into AmberManual but couldn't find it.
Also how to calculate the distribution of Tetrahedral Order Parameter q of Water using cpptraj.
Regards
Saqlain

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Hi,
You can use gist module of cpptraj to calculate the tetrahedral order.
Best,
Satyajit
